events.title: 애스턴 빌라 beat 볼턴 원더러스 on penalties after a goalless draw in the FA Cup semi-final at Wembley, to reach their first FA Cup final for 43 years.
Two 리즈 유나이티드 Fans, Chris Loftus and Kevin Speight are killed on the eve of the club's UEFA Cup Semi-final against 갈라타사라이.
Two goals from Gus Poyet give 첼시 a 2–1 win over 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in the FA Cup semi-final.
A late surge by 미들즈브러 is unable to prevent 맨체스터 유나이티드 from winning a thrilling Premier League 4–3 at the Riverside Stadium .
All Premier League matches kicked off at 3.06 pm, to commemorate the 96 리버풀 supporters who lost their lives in the Hillsborough disaster .

더비 카운티 bring Georgi Kinkladze back to England after two years with Ajax after agreeing a £3 million deal. 맨체스터 유나이티드 surrender their defence of the European Cup after losing 3–2 at home to 레알 마드리드 in the quarter-final second leg.
찰턴 애슬레틱 win promotion back to the Premier League after one season away.
맨체스터 유나이티드 seal their sixth Premier League title in eight seasons with a 3–1 win at 사우샘프턴.
브래드퍼드 시티 boost their survival bid and dent 윔블던's with a 3–0 win at Valley Parade.

April draws to a close with champions 맨체스터 유나이티드 an incredible 19 points ahead of second placed 아스널, who have two games in hand. 리버풀 are looking set for the third Champions League place, while 첼시 head the UEFA Cup race. 리즈 유나이티드 meanwhile have fallen to fifth place after a disastrous run of results, and now look unlikely to even qualify for European competition at all. 애스턴 빌라, 선덜랜드 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 remain in with a slim chance of taking the league's UEFA Cup slot. 찰턴 애슬레틱 have been confirmed as Division One champions, but the race for second place is still being contested by 맨체스터 시티 and 입스위치 타운.
